title: The Hidden Costs of Buying a Home

scenes.fact: Homeownership has ongoing costs like maintenance, averaging 1% of the home's value.
scenes.text: Around 70% of homebuyers forget hidden costs.
Closing costs alone can range from 2% to 5% of the home's price.

scenes.sub: Plan your budget wisely before buying.
